blurb: Life in and around Capital Canyon Club provides an idyllic setting. With tall Ponderosa pines swaying with the whispering winds, and terrain that offers vistas of Prescott Valley and the San Francisco Peaks in Flagstaff, the landscape evokes a soothing sensation that resonates with everyone. The crisp mountain air engulfs the senses enabling one to rejuvenate heart, mind and spirit. This is what makes Capital Canyon
